summary: Unified logging covers Logger levels, per-subsystem levels and privacy, and a log reader (LogStore, bifrost-log). Signposts and the unfair-lock wrapper are missing. Apps get std::sync primitives in place of OSAllocatedUnfairLock.

features.apple: Logger, OSLogType (debug, info, notice, error, fault)
features.note: Logger::new(subsystem, category) with debug/info/notice/error/fault; syslog priorities map to journald. See docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Unified Logging'.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. LogArg: per-value privacy (auto/public/private/sensitive, mask .hash), hex/decimal, fixed float precision, align left/right(columns). Not Midget-verified; no interpolation macro.

features.apple: Customizing Logging Behavior While Debugging (log config)
features.note: bifrost-log config --subsystem X --level debug, override file under /etc/bifrost/log.toml.

features.feature: Logging: reading logs (OSLogStore, log show and stream)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/log.rs:679 (LogStore), :498 (Query), :706 (entries), :729 (stream); wired: springboard/apps/console-desktop/src/model.rs, console.rs (search tokens and saved searches)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. current_process and local (entitlement) stores exist. The journal reader shells out to journalctl. No persistent position tokens (getEntries(at:)). Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: OSSignposter, OSSignpostType, os_signpost_id_t, Legacy Signpost Symbols
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-25, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No interval or event measurement API. Performance history lives in tools/bench.py, not in the app SDK.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 20 tests. Wave 6 (b19, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No unfair-lock wrapper in the SDK. Apps use std::sync::Mutex directly; the poison-recovery helper lock() appears in several modules.

features.feature: Task scheduling used with locks (DispatchGroup, DispatchWorkItem)
features.apple: Not in the os doc; libdispatch is a separate framework
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. Listed for context only. docs/bifrost-ui.md line 1096 says there is no DispatchSource, but dispatch.rs:744 has a memory-pressure DispatchSource. The doc is out of date.
All deprecated in Apple's os framework. Use Logger instead.
Apple linker section for log strings. It has no meaning for the Rust build.

gaps: Signposts: no OSSignposter or os_signpost equivalent (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1041 names it as Phase 3)
OSAllocatedUnfairLock: no unfair-lock wrapper in the SDK
Per-value privacy and format specifiers: privacy is per subsystem only
Log reading: no persistent position tokens and the journal reader depends on journalctl
docs/bifrost-ui.md:1096 says no DispatchSource, but springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs:744 has a memory-pressure source; the doc needs a fix
